summary.title: Executive Summary — The Week in Numbers

blocks.label: The week in one line
blocks.text: Nifty 50 +2.78% · FPI equity -₹7,935 Cr · USD/INR 94.95 · Brent +4.75% · breadth mixed.
FPIs: a net equity outflow of ₹7,935 Cr across 5 NSDL reporting days (1 of 5 positive); debt -₹1,579 Cr.
USD/INR 94.95 (-1.93%, rupee stronger); Brent $109.69 (+4.75%); India 10-year 7.39% (+8 bp); US 10-year 5.10% (-15 bp).
Nifty 50 +2.78% to 23,146.15, Midcap 150 +0.62%, Smallcap 250 +0.36% in the week to 16 Oct.

Of 1,572 coded names in the scan, 923 rose and 641 fell on the week (median +0.75%). Breadth regime: **mixed**, with 34.5% above the 50-DMA and 47.9% above the 200-DMA (-11.0 and -8.1 points over four weeks).
Stage 2 by calculation (all 7 template checks): 312 names, 76 entered and 65 left since 9 Oct. The provider's Stage 2 list (701 names) was not updated this week (the list on file is dated 13 Sep).

SwingEdge sub-sector trackers: 20 of 32 trackers rose. Led by Sugar & Ethanol (+6.72%), Jewellery & Gold Retail (+5.23%), Hotels (+3.79%); lagged by Optical Fibre & Telecom Gear (-3.91%), AI Data Centre (-3.83%), Wires & Cables (-3.40%). The equal-weight market line: +0.91%.

blocks.label: How this report is built
blocks.text: Built automatically by `tools/auto_weekly.py` from data the evening pull already has: the screener.in scan, NSE's index file, NSDL's FPI Monitor, RBI's current rates, Yahoo closes, and SwingEdge's own breadth, Stage 2 and tracker files. No model writes any of it: each sentence is a template filled with the week's numbers. Not collected: DII daily flows and derivatives positioning (no keyless source). Facts only; nothing here rates a stock.
